map.距离 3 km、骑手速度 20 km/h → 基准骑行 = 3÷20×60 =: Distance 3 km, rider speed 20 km/h → baseline riding = 3÷20×60 = 9 minutes. Traffic "normal" ×1.3, weather "light rain" ×1.2, period "lunch peak" ×1.2 → combined coefficient 1.87, adjusted riding = 9×1.87 ≈ 16.9 minutes. Add prep 12 minutes, rider pickup 3 minutes, elevator and upstairs 4 minutes → total about 36 minutes, promised window 31-41 minutes. If traffic changes to "severe congestion" ×2.5, riding rises to 32.4 minutes and total time to about 51 minutes, at which point you should cap orders or warn customers in advance.
